thread:
sara_sales: Heads-up — FinBank EU on tomorrow's POC call. They want strict EU-only processing for the trial. Questions they raised: can we guarantee egress + inference stays in EU, full sub-processor list for the EU region, and what happens if capacity is exhausted — will we ever route to non-EU? Also want a quick cost delta for pinning vs hosted fallback. need answers by EOD.

raj_solutions: Short answers for the call: 1) Hosted API can be constrained to EU regions and we support tenant pinning (sticky routing). 2) Subproc list: we have an EU subproc inventory doc but legal needs to sign off to share vendor details. 3) Failover: default policy is region-failover to nearest healthy region unless you require strict residency — then Dedicated or Private is recommended. 4) Cost: pinning on Hosted = small surcharge + potential egress. Dedicated = higher commit but predictable throughput.

infra_engr: Adding details — we have two routing knobs: tenant_affinity (soft) and tenant_pin (hard). tenant_pin forces all control-plane and data-plane to the selected region; fallback only on manual ops override. tenant_affinity prefers region but will failover automatically.

infra_engr: Example of routing config we can show the customer:
```yaml
routing_policy: 
  mode: tenant_pin # tenant_affinity | tenant_pin
  preferred_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: manual_review # automatic | manual_review
```

raj_solutions: For the POC I suggest we propose tenant_pin with manual_review fallback, and offer a Dedicated quote if they need SLA-backed local capacity.

ops_oncall: Ops note — if we do tenant_pin on Hosted and traffic spikes, autoscaling may be limited by regional GPU inventory. In that case requests could queue or be rejected depending on timeout. We can configure graceful degradation: reduced max tokens or enforced batching to keep within SLOs.

legal_qa: I'll pull the EU subprocessor attestation and the list of vendors that touch EU data. FYI we'll need a minimal NDA+DPA share to give vendor contact details. I can prepare a redacted list for the call.

raj_solutions: Pricing: for a 30-day POC we can do a temporary pinned tenant on hosted with a +15% per-token premium and a cap on max concurrency. Dedicated quote ballpark: monthly commit ~ 3-4x expected POC peak TCO, but removes cross-region failover risk. I'll draft numbers.

sara_sales: Great. Can someone drop a 1-pager we can send to the customer before the call (routing options, failure modes, high level pricing)? Need it in next 3 hours.

infra_engr: Uploading a short PPT + routing snippet to the deal folder now. It includes sample SLA language for manual failover and the config YAML above.

deploy_bot: Ticket INF-7123 created: "POC FinBank EU — pinning + subproc attestation" assigned to infra_engr, ops_oncall, legal_qa. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-7123

legal_qa: I'll attach the redacted EU subproc list to the ticket and add required DPA clause notes.

ops_oncall: For the call — I'll bring the runbook for queued requests and the recommended throttling settings. Also can show logs of a previous geo-pin trial.

raj_solutions: I'll prepare a 2-slide pricing summary (hosted pinned vs dedicated vs private) and call out the delta for BYOK/BYO-KMS if they ask.

sara_sales: Perfect. If we can get the 1-pager + redacted subproc list on the ticket, I'm good to prep the customer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
